{{Quote|All escape pods have been jettisoned. Empty. Uh&hellip; Await further orders. What? What fool ordered that!?|''Empirical'' announcer|<ref name="The Force Unleashed (novel)">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>}}
An '''unnamed officer''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. He selected by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to be part the crew of the ''[[Empirical]]'', a scientific research vessel, around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. He was tasked with informing the crew of the ship's status via intercom system.

==Biography==
At some point, he enlisted in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. He became an officer and was selected by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] to serve on his secret research vessel, the ''[[Empirical]]''.

When Vader's secret apprentice, [[Galen Marek]], was rebuilt aboard the ship following a confrontation with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the vessel was in the [[Dominus system/Legends|Dominus system]]. Marek managed to [[Battle aboard the Empirical|escape]], killing many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and other crew members. When [[PROXY]] set the ship on a collision course with the system's sun, the announcer was unable to escape as PROXY also jettisoned all [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. The announcer was killed with the rest of the crew when the ''Empirical'' plunged into the system star.
